Task force on employment
generation
*161.DR. A.R. KIDWAI:
DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:
Will the PRIME MINISTER be pleased
to state:
(a) whether the Planning Commission
has constituted another task force to
identify sectors, sub-sectors and
economic activities at the State level with
a large potential for employment
generation;
(b) if so, whether Planning
Commission has asked States to bring
about reforms in labour laws for
optimum utilisation of the resources
available in order to create employment
opportunities;
(c) if so, to what extent this task force
have been able to recommend the
methodologies and procedures for the
monitoring of employment and for
gathering information; and
(d) to what extent the target set for
employment in the Tenth Plan would be
fully met?
Liberal credit facilities for small units
*162. SHRI K. KALAVENKATA
RAO: Will the Minister of SMALL SCALE
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) whether small enterprises  are facing
increased competition due to liberalised
imports;
(b) the steps contemplated for resolving
problems being faced by them including
global competition and liberalised imports;
and
(c) whether Government are considering
grant of liberal credit facilities to small units
as part of the steps proposed to be taken?
Increase in software export
*163.SHRI SANTOSH BAGRODIA:
SHRIMATI AMBIKA SONI:
Will the Minister of COMMUNI-
CATIONS AND INFORMATION
TECHNOLOGY be pleased to state:
(a) whether the outbreak of SARS in the
recent past and the slump in economy in
South East Asian Countries has resulted in
increase in software export to the West;
(b) if so, by what percentage;

Manual telephone exchanges of
Jharkhand
†*164. SHRI ABHAY KANT
PRASAD: Will the Minister of
COMMUNICATIONS AND INFORMA-
TION TECHNOLOGY be pleased to state:
(a)  whether it is a fact that Government
propose to convert the manual telephone
exchanges of Jharkhand into electronic ones;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
Employment to youths in Assam
*165. SHRI DWIJENDRA NATH
SHARMAH: Will the Minister of
LABOUR be pleased to state:
(a) whether any target has been fixed to
provide employment to the unemployed
youths of Assam during the Tenth Five Year
Plan period; and
(b) if so, the details thereof?
Meerut-Kotdwar-Badrinath road
†*166. SHRI BALKAVI BAIRAGI:
Will the Minister of ROAD TRANSPORT
AND HIGHWAYS be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that due to slow
pace of construction work on Meerut-
Kotdwar-Badrinath road,  travellers have to
face lot of difficulties;
(b) if so, the reasons for the slow pace
of construction;
(c) whether it is also a fact that the
construction work of this road is crossing
the dead line; and
(d) if so, by when the work is likely to
be completed?
Amendment in the Carriers
Act, 1865
*167. SHRI R.S. GAVAI: Will the
Minister of ROAD TRANSPORT AND
HIGHWAYS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are considering
to bring about an amendment to the Carriers
Act, 1865 as proposed by Bombay Goods
Transport Association;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) if not, the reasons therefor;
and
(d) the measures proposed to be taken to
stop the on-going harassment of the
transporters?
Toll tax on four-lane roads
†*168. SHRI JAYANTILAL BAROT:
Will the Minister of ROAD TRANSPORT
AND HIGHWAYS be pleased to
 state:
(a) the details of four lane roads in the
country, State-wise;
(b) whether Government are considering
to charge toll tax on the four lane roads in
the country;
(c) if so, the States where four lane roads
are already being used for charging toll tax;
and
(d) whether Government are considering
to contract any private company for charging
toll tax on four lane roads?

Life insurance cover for artisans
working for KVIC
*169.SHRIMATI VANGA GEETHA:
SHRI YADLAPATI VENKAT
RAO:
Will the Minister of AGRO AND
RURAL INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) the number of artisans working for
the Khadi & Village  Industries Commission
(KVIC); and
(b) the action proposed to provide a
comprehensive group life insurance cover
to them as a social security measure?

Employees prosecuted by CBI
1177. SHRI R.S. GAVAI: Will the
PRIME MINISTER be pleased to state:
(a) the details of the employees of
Central Government, State Government
and Public Sector Undertakings prosecuted
by CBI in case of corruption and
misappropriation of Government funds
during the last one year in Vidarbha region
of Maharashtra;
(b) the mone y and assets recovered
from them;
(c) the cases pending for investigation;
and
(d) the details of the cases let of after
investigation?
Village industries in Rajasthan
1178. SHRI AIMADUDDIN AHMAD
KHAN (DURRU): Will the Minister of
AGRO AND RURAL INDUSTRIES be
pleased to state:
(a) the number of village industries set
up in Rajasthan during each of the last
three years, industry-wise and year-wise;
(b) the financial allocation of such
industries;
(c) the number of units which are
making profits;
(d) whether there is any proposal under
the consideration of Government to
provide incentives to make them viable;
and
(e) if so, the details in this regard?
PMRY in Madhya Pradesh
†1179. SHRIMATI MAYA SINGH:
Will the Minister of AGRO AND RURAL
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) details of the amount allocated to
Madhya Pradesh under the 'Pradhan
Mantri Rozgar Yojana' during the last
three years, year-wise;
(b) the number of instalments due upto
June, 2003 which have not been released;
(c) whether it is a fact that the State

(d) if so, the details thereof?
Steps to encourage Rural Industries
†1180. SHRI KRIPAL PARMAR: Will
the Minister of AGRO AND RURAL
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware that
the condition of the traditional Rural
Cottage Industries is continuously
deteriorating;
(b) if so, the steps proposed to be taken
by Government to encourage the Rural
Industries; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
Rural industries established by KVIC
in H.P.
†1181. SHRI KRIPAL PARMAR: Will
the Minister of AGRO AND RURAL
INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) the number of Rural Industries
established by Khadi Village Industries
Commission (KVIC) in villages of
Himachal Pradesh and the number of
people working in them;
(b) the number of registered Rural
Industries/Institutions;
(c) the present status of these industries
alongwith the number of industries
earning profit and those running in loss;
(d) whether there is any scheme for
the assistance to the industries which are
running in loss; and
(e) if so, the details thereof?
Agriculture based industries
†1182. SHRI RAM JETHMALANI:
SHRI LAJPAT RAI:
Will the Minister of AGRO AND
RURAL INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have identified
Agriculture based Industries being run in
Rural Areas in different States;
(b) if so, the names of the Major
Industries being run in the rural areas,
State-wise;
(c) the average percentage of the total
persons working in each industry; and
(d) the assessment of per capita income
in these industries?
Proposal for developing Cottage
Industries in Rajasthan
1183. SHRI SURESH KALMADI:
SHRI SANTOSH BAGRODIA:
Will the Minister of AGRO AND
RURAL INDUSTRIES be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have received
any proposals from the Government of
Rajasthan for developing Cottage
Industries in the State; and
(b) the details of fund allocated to the
State for this purpose during the last three
years and the rate of development of
Cottage Industries?

RAO:
SHRI RAVULA CHANDRA
SEKAR REDDY:
Will the Minister of EXTERNAL
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether USA has declined to help
India to set up nuclear power plants;
